newsitem.title: USA: MCN Energy Group to buy MCV stake from PanEnergy.
newsitem.headline: MCN Energy Group to buy MCV stake from PanEnergy.

text.p: MCN Energy Group Inc said Tuesday its MCN Investment Corp unit agreed to purchase PanEnergy Corp's interest in Midland Cogeneration Venture Limited Partnership, which operates the Midland Cogeneration Venture (MCV) facility in Midland, Mich.
MCN Investment has agreed to invest an undisclosed amount for PanEnergy's 18.1 percent equity interest in the partnership.
MCV, the nation's largest cogeneration facility, can produce up to 1,370 megawatts (MW) of electricity and 1.35 million pounds per hour of process steam for industrial use.

"MCV will be an important addition to our overall portfolio of energy- related investments," MCN Investment President Rai Bhargava said. "It is an operating facility that will contribute immediately to our earnings," he said in a statement.

When PanEnergy and Duke Power complete a proposed $7.7 billion merger, the MCV partnership will exceed the percentage ownership by electric utilities allowed by federal law under which MCV operates. Therefore, PanEnergy is required to sell its interest in MCV.

"Although we are disappointed that the company will no longer be a partner in MCV, PanEnergy will continue to pursue ownership and control of those categories of power generation where electric utility ownership limitations do not apply," said Paula Rosput, president of PanEnergy Power Services Inc.
The investment will bring MCN Investment's portfolio of electric power generation projects to a net total of 470 MW.
MCV sells electricity to Consumers Energy Co and Dow Chemical Co under long-term contracts.
Closing of the purchase agreement is expected by May 30 and is subject to certain regulatory approvals.
MCN Energy is a $3.6 billion diversified energy holding company with natural gas markets and investments throughout North America and in India.
PanEnergy operates more than 37,000 miles of natural gas pipeline, delivering gas primarily to the Northeast and Midwest markets.
